name: Seviyan
description: Fine roasted wheat threads — sweetened into kheer, or fried into upma.

ayurveda.note: Shita like wheat, though roasting lightens it.

unani.note: Garam like gehun, and the Eid sheer khurma is built on it.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
